name: submit_desk_assignment
description: submit_desk_assignment: Submit a desk assignment for an employee. The desk code must be one that was confirmed as available. Returns an error if the employee already has an assigned desk (already_assigned), or if their previous assignment is less than 90 days old (too_soon — reassignment cooldown).

employee_id.description: The employee being assigned the desk (e.g. EMP048271).

desk_code.description: The specific desk code to assign (e.g. BLD3-FL2-D107).
